title: Custom Courses
tagline: We build training courses to your SOPs, in your voice, with your logo, on our platform.
summary: For operators with proprietary SOPs, brand-specific training, or multi-unit rollouts, we build custom courses end-to-end — scripting, voiceover, assessment design, LMS hosting. Projects typically ship in 4-6 weeks.
outcomes: Replace your SOP binder with a modern, trackable course
Roll out consistent training across every location
Track completion at the company, location, and employee level
priceNote: Custom pricing — scopes start around $2,500 per course.

faqs.q: How does the custom course process work?
faqs.a: We start with a scoping call, then we draft a script from your SOPs. You review, we record voiceover and build the course in our platform, you approve, and we ship. Typical timeline: 4-6 weeks.
You own the content. Train321 hosts and delivers it on our LMS for the duration of your license.
